checks.name: Escape releases the pending request and progress timer
reopening preserves the draft and shows an editable form
late failed replies after close have no alert
late success after close has no result or second close callback
a superseded reply cannot finish the current loading state
active failure restores the draft and allows manual successful retry
unmount cancels work and ignores an abort-insensitive late rejection
Strict Mode preserves cancellation and a fresh reopen

limits: Actual React modal and response reader; progress time and HTTP replies are controlled.
Transport intentionally ignores abort. Callback suppression is tested separately from native browser abort. No server write executes.
